research_question: Can a bounded sensory template learned from a prior self-only replay support natural-speech self/world binding when source RMS and software levels compensate the measured near-field/far-field path imbalance?

v1_observations_used: maximum development self-only FIR residual ratio 1.441549
minimum development world-only normalized residual ratio 1.0
self-only speech-window acoustic gain approximately 1.125 to 2.306 relative to pre-callback PCM
world-only speech-window acoustic gain approximately 0.029 to 0.074 relative to pre-callback PCM
changes_allowed: replace per-trial chirp-deconvolved FIR with a prior self-only sensory template
RMS-normalize source excerpts with fixed peak caps
change software playback gains while preserving physical geometry and hardware controls
use a fresh already-spent corpus panel and keep all new overlap trials held out
changes_not_allowed: post-hoc thresholding of the failed v1 run
reuse of any v1 source in v2
change to physical speaker or microphone geometry
use of condition labels by the runtime representation

stimulus_boundary.corpus: Music Lab speech recordings already spent by prior Cora analyses but not used by workspace v1
stimulus_boundary.excerpt_rule: Downmix to mono, resample linearly to 16000 Hz, select the 600 ms non-overlapping window with greatest RMS using earliest-index tie breaking, and remove its mean.

normalization.rule: Scale to target RMS, then uniformly reduce only if the role-specific peak cap would be exceeded.

candidate_world_evidence.name: prior_self_replay_template_residual_ratio
runtime_inputs: earlier self-calibration capture for that identity
candidate_world_evidence.method: Store the chirp-aligned 600 ms sensory consequence from the earlier self-calibration replay. For a later self-bearing event with matching identity, estimate one gain scalar from the current and stored chirp windows, subtract the gain-scaled stored speech template, and divide residual RMS by current captured RMS. World-only evidence is 1.0 because no self template is predicted.
candidate_world_evidence.causal_order_required: self_calibration precedes self_probe and overlap for every pair
candidate_world_evidence.template_memory_bound: three workspace slots, each retaining one 600 ms mono template plus one chirp window; no cross-session growth
candidate_world_evidence.threshold_rule: maximum development self-probe residual ratio plus 10 percent of the clean gap to the minimum development world-only ratio

fixed_live_levels_if_design_passes.derivation: Use RMS-normalized excerpts and compensate the v1 measured path imbalance without changing physical geometry. Self is reduced 6 dB and world increased 18 dB relative to v1. The world chirp is reduced 12 dB in PCM to limit its net alignment-chirp increase to 6 dB.

spent_data_design_gate.channel: deterministic repeated-path synthetic captures over the exact fresh v2 speech excerpts
spent_data_design_gate.decision_rule: Implement only this frozen v2 candidate. If any gate fails, retain it without tuning on held-out trials. A material template, normalization, level, or threshold change requires a new preregistration.

live_boundary_if_design_passes.geometry: Unchanged XVF3800 :0 / Mac mini self at 4 cm and 100 percent / External Headphones device 2 at 180 degrees and 50 cm with hardware knob approximately 50 percent / semi-quiet room with laptop fan

claim_boundary: A pass would test exact-efference sensory binding after one prior replay, not a generalized self-voice model, speech understanding, or biological corollary discharge. The 600 ms sensory templates are explicitly bounded episodic state rather than learned semantic representations.
